hypotheses.name: Player-pair compatibility
hypotheses.hypothesis: Role-complementary player pairs may improve ball progression or defensive stability beyond additive individual performance.
hypotheses.example: Zenit: Douglas Santos + Pedro versus Roman Vega + John John (owner-provided author interpretation).
hypotheses.method: Within-club, opponent/score-state/role-adjusted paired-segment contrasts, minimum-minute gate, uncertainty intervals; do not infer causal effect.
